lesson: The system is failing to distinguish between genuine structural reversals and liquidity sweeps, resulting in premature entries during high-volatility chop. By prioritizing SMC-based CHoCH signals without confirming institutional order flow, the strategy is consistently getting trapped in counter-trend traps.
adjustment: Require a confirmed break and retest of a significant daily supply/demand zone before initiating any position, ignoring all 15m/1h CHoCH signals until the daily trend aligns.
methodology_flag: Trust lower-timeframe SMC signals less on DOTUSDT; prioritize daily structural levels.
